description.value: M Cafe is a casual Pan-Asian restaurant in Creekside Plaza along Barnet Highway in Coquitlam, serving everything from Hong Kong-style milk teas and fried rice noodles to Singaporean vermicelli, Japanese-inspired mini hot pots, and Western staples like rack of lamb and lobster fettuccine. The broad menu and dine-in atmosphere make it a solid fuelling stop for cyclists riding the Barnet Highway corridor. Online ordering via a dedicated mobile app is available for both takeout and dine-in.
